CHANGES REQUIRED after independent review of execute-plans PRs #510/#511/#512 (latest merge 0a306d1a56d5069528642352d77e27031cdb154d). Clean exact-contract regeneration and hashes are valid, focused runtime tests pass (12 files/175 tests), production build passes, and CI run 29974272391 is green; however generated DTO binding does not TypeScript-compile. 'npx tsc --project tsconfig.app.json --noEmit --pretty false' reports task-scope errors: candidatePool.ts imports nonexistent CandidateComponentDigest, CandidateFieldProvenance, CandidatePoolMember; workshops.ts and agora-dtos-binding.test.ts import nonexistent WorkshopReadinessAssessment; the binding fixture assigns string to NoDirectActionProof. The generator handles definitions but not JSON Schema $defs, so CandidateScoreResult.components becomes Array<unknown>, introducing downstream CandidateReviewDrawer type failures. Fix generator/ref resolution (including $defs), bind clients to actual generated names while preserving the complete v1.4 base member plus v1.13 truth projection, replace erased type-only Vitest assertions with a real TypeScript compile/typecheck gate in CI, and emit the required structured machine-readable five-field frontend compatibility handoff rather than only a prose next string. Re-run two clean exact-commit regenerations, contract tests, task-focused Agora/strict BFF tests, tsc gate, production build, and merge the corrective PR to execute-plans dev before review.
